scope: Only state expression panels and previews; no asset texture or runtime code edits.

reusePolicy.panel: Nine-slice based on existing 32px-of-138px inset; corners kept proportional.
reusePolicy.icons: Uniform scale only; original PNGs unchanged.
reusePolicy.text: All text is separately rendered into preview pages. Nothing is baked into reusable input textures.
